content: Jesús Pilatoʼse sesmalad
Wakdargusgu, bela dule-irwa-Babse-gormalad-e-dummagan, degi, Judío-girmar-dummagan-neggwebur-sedimalad igar-itosmargu, igar-mesismalad, Jesús-oburgwemaloye.
Edinnar neggwebur-dakmaid-Poncio-Pilatoʼye-nugadse Jesús-sesmalad. Jesúsʼga igar-itogega aga ukdapmalad.
Judas na dukin oburgwisad

Geb degi, Jesús-darba-uksad-dule-Judas, Jesús-oburgwilego-daksagu, bukib-binsaded. A-ular, Judas mani-sibu-dulagwen-gakambegwad (30) gannar dule-irwa-Babse-gormalad-e-dummaganse, degi, Judío-girmar-dummaganse senonikid.
Amarga sognonikid: —An dummad-nosad, dule-ibmar-gwen-oakalossulid binsa darba an uksad. Ar dummagandi, abin-imakdemalad: —¿Ar anmargardi baisi? ¡Ar wedi, begindo!
Geb degi, Judas Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi mani-mide nadsunnad. Geb agi na dukin gammu gadapid.

Dule-irwa-Babse-gormalad-e-dummagan, Judas-mani-mided-wesmargu, sogdemalad: “We-mani anmar Bab-Dummadga-mani-sabogedgi uker, igar-nuedsulid, ar ade, we-mani bato ukabsalegaled, dule-gindakega-imakoed-manid.”
Geb dummagan igar-itosmargu, napsa-ibmarga-sobleged-nainu baksamalad, adi, agi dulemar-ainebarmalad-burgwisar, digmalagar.
A-ular, a-nainu amba emi-ibase bileged: “Ablis-Nainuye.”
Ar deyob gunonikid, igi Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged Jeremíasʼye-nugad, deun sogsagusgu:

content.text: ar igi Bab-Dummad anga sogsa, aba igar imaklesad.”

content: Zacarías 11:12-13
Pilato, Jesúsʼga igar-itosad
Dule-dummad-negdakmaid-Pilatoʼye-nugad-asabin Jesús gwisgudapid. Pilato Jesúsʼse egichialid, ega sogded: —¿Ar be Judíoʼmar-E-Rey? Jesús, abin-sogded: —Ar bede soged.
Dule-irwa-Babse-gormalad-e-dummagan, degi, Judío-girmar-dummagan ar Jesúsʼgi sognanai-guarmalad, we, igar-isgana imakdiiye. Ar Jesúsʼdi gwen abin-imaksasulid.
Geb degi, Pilato Jesúsʼga sogded: —¿Begi-sunmaknanaid be itosuli, bede ibmar-isgana imakdiiye?
Ar Jesúsʼdi bipisaale gwen abin-imaksasulid. Degisoggu, Pilato nue-geger daksunnad, ar ibiga wede Jesús dulemar-abin-imaksuli.
Pilato, Jesúsʼga burgwed-igar mesisad
Emide dakleargu, iba-onolealile, Pilato gusgu Judíoʼmar-abemaladba dule-wargwen-esgaryagi-mellesiid ega onodaed.
Deunni, a-ibagangine, dule-Barrabásʼye nugad esgaryagi mellesiid. We-dule, dule-isgana-nug-nikagwadid.
Dulemar-bukidar ambikunonimargu, Pilato amarga sokalid: —¿Doa bemarga onobi be an-abemarsunna? ¿An bemarga Barrabás-onoge? ¿Jesús, Cristoʼye-nugad an onoge?
Ar ade, Pilato wisid, Judío-dummagan nobedbali ega Jesús-uksamala.
Pilato igar-naboged-gangi-sigu, e-ome ese gaya barmialid: “We-dule, dule-nuedid, dule-isgudisulidid. Mer egi be yolemogo. Emi an ichakwa-gabdakmai oibosad, an egi gabdaksadgi nue-nunmak an itodiid.”
Ar dule-irwa-Babse-gormalad-e-dummagandi, degi, Judío-girmar-dummagan yamo dulemar-binsaed gasmalad, adi, Pilatoʼse Barrabás-egismalaga, ega onogega, Jesúsʼdi oburgwemalagar.
Pilato gannar dulemarga sogdebalid: —¿Doa bur wemar-warbogwad bemarga onobi be an-abemala? Emar abin-sogdemalad: —Barrabás bur be anmarga onoge.
Geb degi, Pilato dulemarga sogdesunnad: —Ar degite, Jesús, Cristoʼye-nugad, ¿igi an imakosunna? Bela abin-sogdemalad: —¡We-duledi be nakrusgi bioke!
Pilato dulemarga sogdebalid: —¿Ar degite, we-dulede ibu ibmar-isgana wede imaksasunna? Agi dulemar bur bule oimakdemalad, sogdemalad: —¡We-dule nakrusgi bioke!
Pilato dakdegu gwen igar nabolesuli, aka bur bule dulemar oimakbukwa, bormogi dii-susgua, na e-argan dulemar-wagab enukded, sogded: —Bemar we-dule-nued-oburgoed, anginsurdo, bemargindo.
Bela-dulemar abin-sogdemalad: —We-dule-oburgwilegoed anmargi naguoe, degi, anmar-mimmigangi nagumogoe.
Geb degi, Pilato, Barrabás-onossunnad. Pilato, Jesús-sabsur-bibyosad-sorba, nakrusgi Jesús-biokmalaga, suar-ibmalaga uksasunnad.
Suar-ibmala Jesúsʼgi dodosad
Degi, Pilato-e-suaribmala, Pilato-neg-Pretorioʼye-nugadse Jesús-sesmalad. Agi suar-ibmala, degi, e-sordamar bela-danagwenad, Jesús-ebilis ambikunonimalad.
Suar-ibmala Jesús-ibe mor-esusmargu, reymor-ginnid-yoedgiid Jesúsʼga yosmarsunnad.

E-nonogi iko-sobaled-gurgin ega sismarbalid, ega masargiid gaapoledyob e-argan-nuedgi ega uksamarbalid. Geb degine, Jesús-asabin yokorgi-sindigar sigisdamalad, yamo egi dodonaigusdamalad, ega sogdedamalad: —¡Be Judíoʼmar-E-Rey, suibaksaar be ani gudigusana gadin!
Suar-ibgan Jesúsʼgi wiaksadamarbalid, masargiid e-annik sudamalad, geb agi e-nonogi sarsodamarbalid.
Suar-ibgan Jesúsʼgi-dodosmalad-sorba, mor-ginnid ega esusmalad, gannar ega e-mor yosmalad. Geb degi, nakrusgi-biokmalaga Jesús-sesmarsunnad.
Jesús nakrusgi bioklesad
Roma-dulemar-suar-ibgan Jesús-nakrusgi-biokegala, Jerusalén-neggweburgi nodmargu, dule-wargwen-Cirene-neggweburgined Simónʼye-nugad dakarmalad. A-dule, Jesúsʼga nakrus-seega ise-barmiar imaksamalad.
Gólgotaʼye-neg-nugadse modapmalad. Gólgota sogleged, Dule-Nonogar-Negye.
A-negse modapmargu, suar-ibgan vino ina-gagbidbo-oburaledgi Jesús-ogobdemalad, adi, dog mer bar nunmaked itogegar. Ar Jesúsʼdi wis-itosgua, yapa abin-gobgusad.

Suar-ibgan Jesús-nakrusgi-bioksamargu, Jesús-morgi dodoarmalad, doa suoeddibeye. Wilubdakar Jesús-mor mimismarsunnad. Deyob gusad, adi, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-epenne-sogsadyob guegar, deun sogsagusgu:
Salmo 22:18
Degine, geb Jesúsʼgi-nakulemalaga suar-ibgan sigismalad.
E-nakrus-birgi narmaksamalad, sogega, ibiga Jesús burgwenai. Narmakaled weyob sognaid: We-Jesús Judíoʼmar-E-Reyd
Geb degi, suar-ibgan dulemar-atursamalad-warbo nakrusgi bioksamarbalid. Wargwen, Jesús-argan-nuedsik ogwichisad, baiddi Jesús-argan-sapiledsik ogwichisbalid.
Dulemar-Jesús-dikarba-nasdamalad ise-dodoar egi nasdamalad, yamo ega nono-ege-ege-gunadap nasdamalad,
ega sogdedamalad: —Ar be Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg be earoye sogsad, degi, ibapaagi gannar sobbaloye be sogsad. Emigindi, na be dukin bendakdo. Ar be Bab-Dummad-Machile, nakrusgi-naid be aidedage.
Amba deyob, dule-irwa-Babse-gormalad-e-dummagan, Garda-Narmaked-Dulemar, Fariseoʼmar, degi, Judío-girmar-dummagan, amar bela Jesúsʼgi dododmarmogad, sogdemarmogad:
—We-Jesús, dule-baigandi nabir bendaksad, edi dukin geg na bendaked. Ar Jesús Israel-Dulemar-E-Reyle, nakrusgi-naid aidedadeen, geb agi anmar egi benguosulid.
We-dule Bab-Dummadgi-gwen-bengusurye-sogedde, Bab-Dummad nabir e-dakye-sogele, degite, Bab-Dummad e-bendakdado. ¿Ar na sogsasursi, ‘Ani an Bab-Dummad-Machiye?’
Amba deyob atursamalad-Jesúsʼba-nakrusgi-bioklegar-naimalad Jesúsʼgi-dodonanai gusmarmogad.
Jesús-burgwisad
Dad yorukugusgu, bela we-napa-naidgi negasichid nagunonikid, wachi-irbaase naigusad.
Wachi-irbaa-gusgu, Jesús binnasur goted, sogded:
Salmo 22:1
Abar Jesús-nakrus-walik-bukmalad Jesús-degi-soge-itosmargu, sogdemalad: —Wede Elíasʼse gornaid.
Degine, dule-wargwen, yoga-abarmakar naded, ibmar-buta-butad-susgua vino-gagbidgi owardikusad, geb suar-dukugi edichagu, wis gobega Jesúsʼga uksad.
Ar baigandi sogdemalad: —Mer ese achamar, dakmalo bule Elías odenonikodibe.
Geb Jesús gannar binnasur-gotebargu, agi yasuu naded.
Deyob-gunaidgine, Jerusalénʼgi, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi, Neg-Islidikid-irwa-mor-naid siir naded. Niba-akar urbalidse achirmakde gusad. Degine, napneg giglimakded, akwa-dummagan mamaridbalid.
Neg-uanmar argadbalid, bukidar-dule-gwage-swilidikmalad-burgwismalad durgudmalad.
Amar neg-uangi-mamaid ainidmalad. Wemala, Jesús-gannar-durgusad-sorba, geb Jerusalén-neggwebur-islidikidse dognonimalad. Dulemar-bukidarse magarosmalad.

Roma-suar-ibed-sordamar-dulatar-sediid (100), degine, e-sordamar, Jesús-edarbebukmalad, negabandur-nagusad-daksamargu, degi, bela ibmargusad-daksamargu, bela nue-dobe-ito nadmalad, sogdemalad: —We-dule, nue-Bab-Dummad-Machi-sunnadid.
Agi bukidar-omegan bannabasaar Jesús-dakbuk-gusmarmogad. Ar a-omegan Galilea-akar Jesúsʼba bipirmakdanimalad, ega ibmar-imakdii gusmalad.
A-omegan-abargi María-Magdalena gwichid, degi, María-gwichimogad. A-María, Santiago-e-nanad, degi, José e-nanad. Deginbali, Zebedeo-machimala-e-nan gwichi gusmogad.
Jesús-diglesad
Neg-sedodgu, mani-ibed-wargwen, Joséʼye-nugad nonikid. We-dulede Arimateaʼginedid, Jesús-e-sapinga gusmogad.
We-dule, Pilatoʼse nadegusad, Jesús-mui neg-uanse-dignaega egisdapid. Geb degi, Pilato, Joséʼga-Jesús-mui-ukmalaga igar uksad.
José, Jesús-mui-nakrusgi-naid-odesgu, atued-binidgi nue-obipirmaksad.
Geb degi, José na e-neg-uan-binidgi Jesús-mesisad. A-neg-uande akwa-imbaba nuesaale akwiargalad. Geb José neg-uan-doged-eduega egi akwa-dummad obaparmaksad. Geb agi nadsunnad.
José, Jesús-mui-dignaigu, María-Magdalena, baid Maríaʼye-nugbalid, neg-uan-asabin bukwa gusmarmogad.
Suar-ibgan neg-uan-edarbismalad
Banedgine, Judíoʼmar-obunnoged-ibagine, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan, degi, Fariseoʼmar Pilatoʼse nonimalad,
ega sogdemalad: —Dummad, anmar insado, we-dule-yardakegwad amba dula gudigu, sogsagusad: ‘Ibapaagwad-sorba gannar an durguoye.’

Degisoggu, neg-uangi mer dule yogasaar-dogega ibapaa-wilub be igar mese. Ar abakalegi, e-sapingan mutik Jesús-mui atursanonimalale, geb dulemarga sokarmalale: ‘Burgwar-mamaimalad-abargi Jesús durgusye.’ Ar degiir, bur bule idualedba dulemar-yardakoed.
Geb degi, Pilato amarga sogded: —Nabir. Ar degiile, wegi-suar-ibmala-bukwad be neg-uanse sedmar. Na be-itogedba be imakmarsun.
Geb degi, amar neg-uanse nadmarsunnad. Dulemar mer neg-uan egamalaga, akwa-yawagakgi-siidgi Roma-saila-wilub nasiksamalad. Degine, neg-uan edarbemalaga, suar-ibmala ogwichismarbalid.
